Gauri Mehta
Digital Marketing Manager | Kolkata
gauri.mehta278@example.com | +91 9899779546

Experienced digital marketer with a track record of driving acquisition and engagement through data-driven campaigns and SEO-led content strategies. Strong focus on improving ROI using analytics platforms and marketing automation, with cross-functional collaboration to deliver measurable growth. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Tata Consultancy Services, Nov 2024 - Present
Digital Marketing Manager — Remote
- Led an SEO initiative that increased organic sessions by 38% in six months using targeted on-page optimization and content gap analysis; tracked progress via Google Analytics.
- Implemented HubSpot workflows and lead scoring to reduce lead qualification time by 42%, improving marketing-qualified lead to sales conversion.
- Launched a social media marketing calendar across LinkedIn and Twitter, resulting in a 55% increase in engagement rate and a 22% uplift in referral traffic.
- Collaborated with analytics and development teams on tagging and event tracking, improving funnel visibility and enabling monthly performance reports in Google Analytics.

NimbusSoft, Oct 2022 - Oct 2024
Performance Marketer — Hybrid
- Managed Google Ads campaigns across search and display, lowering cost-per-acquisition by 31% while maintaining conversion volume.
- Conducted SEO audits and implemented technical fixes that improved organic keyword rankings, contributing to a 27% increase in organic leads year-over-year.
- Built dashboards in Google Analytics to segment traffic by channel and campaign, enabling budget reallocation that increased marketing ROI by 18%.
- Coordinated A/B tests for landing pages and ad copy, optimizing conversion rates and informing SEM bid strategies.

Trellis Systems, Nov 2021 - Sep 2022
Performance Marketer — On-site
- Executed social media marketing campaigns that grew follower base by 40% and generated a 20% monthly increase in demo requests.
- Deployed HubSpot for campaign automation and lead nurturing, shortening lead response time and improving MQL velocity.
- Managed Google Ads search campaigns focused on high-intent keywords, achieving a 24% improvement in click-through rate and consistent conversion performance.
- Optimized SEM keywords and negative keyword lists to reduce wasted spend and improve average position for priority terms.

Projects
- Local SEO Revamp: Conducted a localized SEO project for a regional SaaS pilot, implementing schema, citation cleanup, and content localization; resulted in a 3x increase in calls from local search within 4 months.
- Analytics Tagging Overhaul: Led tagging and event taxonomy work across multiple sites using a Linux-based deployment workflow, standardizing Confluence documentation for the analytics team.

Skills
SEO; Google Ads; Google Analytics; Social Media Marketing; HubSpot; SEM; Linux; Confluence
